author: dietermusic

title: No need to waste your time to learn new apps it’s simple !
body: Thefor is the best app for people who don’t want to waste time learning new apps. It’s simple, fast, and perfect if you’re always on the go. Journaling takes less than 3 minutes, so it doesn’t eat into your day. I’m in the military, and I know how valuable time is—this app respects that.
author: Niki13625631

title: Best habit tracker out there
body: As someone who is diagnosed with ADHD, I need to master routines so I don’t fall off track. I’ve tried so many productivity tools out there—I’ve made habit trackers on notion and even used other habit tracker apps on the appstore but they just weren’t effective. Finding this app though CHANGED the game for me. The UI is intuitive, simple, and it’s easier than ever for me to keep up with my daily/weekly routines. Couldn’t recommend enough!
author: crystaliokkli

title: Fantastic Habit Tracker
body: I tried many of the habit trackers and have found this one to be the best and the great thing about that is that you can track as many habits as you want for free. It does what you want it do, track habits, and allows lots of flexibility in how you track; daily, weekly, 3 times per week, etc… I like that you can color code and order the habits. I order for morning til nighttime. You can also have habits disappear off your list once completed. Of all the apps I tried this has the best options for tracking habits you do a certain amount of times in a week, instead of just once a day. I can keep my exercise streak alive 6 days a week and not worry about taking Sundays off and losing my streak. This app should be used by a lot more people as it’s better than so many of the other more expensive paid apps.
author: Jfasioe

title: Perfectly Simple
body: You don’t know how many habit tracker apps I tried before finding this one. All I wanted was a place to track my habits and view my monthly progress without all the extra bells and whistles. Even better - there’s no constant barrage of prompts asking you to upgrade! This app is perfect and exactly what I was looking for. If you’re searching for a simple and aesthetically pleasing habit tracker, this is the app you want!
author: Kjkr2023

title: Amazing / UNLIMITED HABITS!!
body: All I wanted from a habit tracker is for it to look clean and let me track as many things as I want for free. THIS IS BOTH. And there’s a cute widget I can put on my home screen as the cherry on top. Thank you so much to the creators of this app for making something simple and effective!
author: JupiterBee_

title: Simple yet efficient
body: I’m looking for something simple to keep track of my habits. I’ve tried almost 10 apps. While I deleted all others instantly because they didn’t meet my requirements for a simple solution. This one stay and I love it. The color scheme is easy on the eyes. The way it works just what I wanted. It would be nice if they add cutes icons, but so far so good!
author: haphanthi

title: Please make a widget!
body: Love this app, great and simple. Easy to use and I love that you can have as many tasks as you want which is rare for free apps. Would be AMAZING if there was a widget for the home screen to give you a look at what tasks you have left for the day and to keep them in your mind.
author: ellerond

title: More widgets please!
body: App works perfectly, would love the option to see the month view for each habit as a widget!
author: sh221bbkr

title: Simple
body: I’ve tried many habit tracking apps, but I like this one the most— especially because of its simplicity. Would definitely recommend people. I wish that it has an option for completion sound when I complete a daily habit though.

title: Nice app but subscription not working
body:
Nice simple app.
